9377P4.title: Fun in the Rain

9377P4.title: Great experience!

105902P7.author: Cassiopee_H

105902P7.title: Tale of Two Towns
105902P7.text: The tours were a great combination of two very unique townships. Setenil was a village built into a cave. Ronda was a town built between a canyon. 105902P7.author: Elsa_G

105902P7.title: We had a very pleasant...

We were offered a small drink and a sweet there. Highly recommend this add on tour.

384801P1.author: Elsa_G

423057P4.title: This was a great tour,...
423057P4.text: This was a great tour, and the Alhambra is a must visit if in Spain, truly amazing. Our guide Carlos was excellent. He was very knowledgeable about all the details of the history. He also had set up a great tour route that took us aside from the larger groups and gave us a comprehensive understanding of the construction, the different historical periods, all the main players, and the dynamics of the area over the last several thousand years. Highly recommended.
423057P4.author: Andrew_T

423057P4.title: The best day at an impressive historical site

Once we got to Alhambra, we met our tour guide Amir. He spoke excellent English and was extremely informative regarding the site and it’s history. The architecture and engineering are truly amazing and I am so glad that we went. I could’ve spent even more time there than we did. At the end of the tour, we opted to go back to Malaga, our driver, Jesus, had agreed to give us a short tour of the city. He took us to several sites in the city and we wer

423057P4.title: Everything went as...
423057P4.text: Everything went as planned.  Our guide, Sow, was so enthusiastic and anxious to make we enjoyed our experience fully.
423057P4.author: Tara_E

150057P1.title: 100% worth doing it!
150057P1.text: It was magical! After like 10min. they told us that dolphines are in front of us. The crew always keept their distance, never chased the animals and let them decide if they wanted to stay with us. Luckily they were so calm, they swam around our boat for like 1h and even stayed with us when we where on our way back. So so happy. We saw so many and also babies, it was truly magical.
150057P1.author: Loredana_S

150057P1.title: See the dolphins off the Benalmadena coast
150057P1.text: A great opportunity to see dolphins on this well organised boat.  We went out on the 12.00 noon boat and were lucky enough to see quite a few dolphins.  Getting on and off the boat was well done with their staff helping folk on and off the boat.  The cruise included a short account of the type of dolphins seen.  The boat we were on also came back along the coast giving everyone great views of the Benalmadena coast line.
150057P1.author: 438cecilh

150057P1.title: Had a beautiful boat trip...

Had a beautiful boat trip and saw 5 dolphins

458652P3.title: A wonderful day trip to the Alhambra from Malaga

Upon arrival at the entry gate to the Alhambra complex, we were introduced to our certified guide.  The six of us from the cruise ship were joined by 6 others.  We were given quiet box sets and moved through the gardens and palaces in an unrushed manner.  We had time to use the restrooms before the tour began, and  between the garden and palace visits.  We also visited a specialty shop and watched the craftsman create a complex inlaid wood piece.  

The driver was only a drive

458652P3.title: Amazing really enjoyed it!

Amazing tour, everything was spot on, really enjoyed it and the tour guide was great, very knowledgeable.

11030P18.title: Excellent tour and tour guide.

The trip back to Malaga was awesome especially—- as we were all singing !!!

Can definitely recommend the trip and the fantastic people organising it. If you wonder about coming here, don't hesitate. Just take plenty of sunscreen, and choose the "high season" but balanced weather months, like October or November.

Frigiliana is a charming and picturesque little village. It was lovely to enjoy a morning coffee there while taking in the beautiful views. Nerja was equally stunning, with breathtaking scenery and plenty of free time to explore at our own pace.

The meeting start/end point was conveniently located close to the cruise ship shuttle stop, about a 5 minute stroll. We’d never ridden on a Segway before, but our apprehensions were put to rest after just a few minutes of test driving and feeling at ease on the Segways with the starts, stops, and turns.

We have been to a cooking course in Bologna before through GetYourGuide and we only have positive experiences and words for it. So DON'T MISS OUT ON THESE EXPERIENCES no matter where you go.

We were grateful for Isabel's excellent English but she encouraged us to try Spanish phrases and coached us on Andalucian pronunciation in a lighthearted way. An excellent experience and a great guide!

We explored river, mountain and coastal habitat and saw a range of birds including flamingo and kingfisher, a large pod of dolphin, amphibians and reptiles and some dragonflies we had not seen before. We are quite happy to look for any wildlife but Florent asked what we wanted to see and could take you to the best places for your interests. We just wish we could explore for more days! 

Florent is so knowledgeable and shares his passion for all flora and fauna through the trip, we learned a lot. The trip is quite ec

382835P1.title: A great birdwatching excursion
382835P1.text:
We had a great day birdwatching with Florent  at Guadalhorce Nature Reserve and nearby coastal spots. He was good company and was very knowledgeable about birds, plants and local nature. He spoke good English (with a French accent) and knew where to find the most interesting birds. His high quality telescopes were great, and we saw 50+ birds including white- headed duck, marbled duck, avocet, spoonbill, flamingo, black-winged stilt, booted eagle and osprey. We had a most enjoyable day.
The reserve has well-sited bird hides, and the paths are good, but there are no facilities such as toilets.

183304P6.title: Be sure you are fit for this one!
183304P6.text:
Breathtaking scenic vistas, interesting information from our guide Alfonso.

I would describe it as strenuous: steep ascents (according to my Fitbit, we climbed the equivalent of 45 stories), rocky paths, and a walk for perhaps a mile along a sometimes crumbly concrete irrigation channel with only a wire fence between you and the ground far below. 102398P2.text: This was an excellent tour and our guide, Javier, was exceptional!  This was a great way to start our trip in Marabella!
102398P2.author: Q7539PRpatriciah

102398P2.title: Old Town Magic
102398P2.text: We really enjoyed the Old Town tour of Marbella which provided the perfect mix of history and geography along side the shopping and dining available in the area. Ending with the olive oil tasting capped a nice jaunt through a beautiful part of Marbella. The guide was effervescent and knowledgeable and provided nice suggestions for other things to do in the area.
102398P2.author: petemT4245LV

214764P2.title: This was great fun
214764P2.text: Taking the buggy through town was great, since  we had no other transport during our stay. Your drivers license is required!! The buggy was easy to manage and this took us up some mountain tracks with views of dams, rock of Gibraltar and a herd of friendly goats. It had rained the day before so we had puddles. Noisy, bouncy and lots of fun.
214764P2.author: Ruannelloyd

214764P2.title: Long walk to the buggies
214764P2.text: The experience was great however when we arrived the shop front was closed with a metal grill over it, none of the phone numbers were answered! Eventually the shop opened around ten minutes after the meeting time, the booking in process seemed to take forever and then we're told to come on this way follow me with no explanations, over a quarter of a mile later we reached an underground parking garrage where we were shown the buggies after this it was fantastic, great view and off-road fun! Make sure you take your driving licence because you will be driving on public roads for some of the trip,
214764P2.author: johndB1222GW

214764P2.title: Family time out of the city.
214764P2.text: Amazing with all the family to be away in the beautiful mountains for 2hr well worth it.
214764P2.author: GerardM1857

5577668P3.title: Fantastic place!!
5577668P3.text: This was our first time visiting and if we are ever in Marbella again we will definitely be back! Amazing golf experience, super friendly staff and great atmosphere. Fantastic family day out specially on a rainy day. Will highly recommend x
5577668P3.author: Karolina_S

5577668P3.title: Fun afternoon in Marbella
5577668P3.text: Absolutely brilliant new find in Marbella. The interior is just amazing, top atmosphere and the staff make you feel really welcome and give you loads of tips on the way round. Fully air conditioned and fully stocked bar, we treated ourselves to the champagne! As a group of 4 we had the best fun afternoon. Highly recommend if you’re visiting Marbella, loads of little bars and restaurants nearby
5577668P3.author: JoWatson70

5584873P4.title: Flamenco show
5584873P4.text: We had an unforgettable evening at this flamenco show—it was easily one of the highlights of our trip to Fuegarolla, Spain. From the moment the performance began, the raw emotion, energy, and passion in the room were electric. Great show!
5584873P4.author: Elena_Z

5584873P4.title: Flamenco Dinner
5584873P4.text: This was an amazing evening! Even though I was solo, the staff were really attentive. The flamenco dancers were fantastic. I thoroughly recommend a booking, food was great too!!
5584873P4.author: plum1963

5584873P4.title: Great activity for the whole family
5584873P4.text: Excellent show and great value. Intimate restaurant setting with amazing food.
5584873P4.author: belindam421

318484P1.title: Definitely worth the...
318484P1.text: Definitely worth the trip! Not only do you get a great view driving through the mountains to get there, you get to truly see the process from beginning to end on how good quality EVOO is made.
318484P1.author: Layne_T

318484P1.title: New found appreciation of Olive Oil!
318484P1.text:
We saw the whole olive oil process from tree to bottle, learnt so much and have a new appreciation for Olive Oil!
The tasting at the end was superb!
318484P1.author: Daveple

318484P1.title: Unforgettable experience
318484P1.text: Very nice discovery of olive oil production with a guide who was very knowledgeable about the whole process in impeccable French. Very good sensory analysis on the discovery of the different olive oils. Very nice experience that we recommend doing.
318484P1.author: 696herv_s

110804P922.title: Made a Wonderful day out
110804P922.text: Literally our favourite day in Marbella! The best and cheapest day out, was a brilliant walking tour, you can pause to audio at any point to stop for food/drinks. Very informative and most importantly we saw way more of Marbella old town than we would have without this tour. Worth every penny and will be doing more over the world from now on. We got to see some beautiful street and buildings with their history and also things like turtles etc.
110804P922.author: TravellingClo

110804P922.title: Beautiful way to visit Marbella at your own pace
110804P922.text: Visit that can be done at your own pace. I did it with my 81 year old mother over 3 days. Very interesting.
110804P922.author: Chantal_D

110804P922.title: Great option for touring Marbella
110804P922.text: Fantastic self-guided tour. Easy to use the app and listen to historic stories of Marbella while walking. Appreciated the suggestions of good spots to snack and dine.
110804P922.author: C3620QWlaurenr

5638486P1.title: Holiday highlight
5638486P1.text: A fantastic couple of hours on the sea. The boat is lovely and the crew are friendly. We were offered drinks as we left the port- cava, juice or fizzy. We quickly found a pod of dolphins who swam around our boat inquisitively, providing magical views. We then went swimming off the boat, which was really fun. The 2 hours flew by and we enjoyed another drink as we headed back to the port.
5638486P1.author: Katie_T

5638486P1.title: What an experience!
5638486P1.text:
What a brilliant way to spend a couple of hours on a comfortable boat with an absolutely fantastic crew. They were kind, caring, and somehow seemed to have a direct line to the dolphins’ social calendar. 
We have a great time sailing around sipping cava as the crew patiently tracked them down.
The trip didn’t ever feel rushed, we even had time for stop off and a swim. 
When we finally found the dolphins, it was pure magic. The captain creating waves for the dolphins to play in. 

A perfect mix of relaxation, laughs, and unforgettable wildlife spotting. We loved every minute of it and will defi
5638486P1.author: KayS87

5638486P1.title: The best experience of my life with the best people in Spain!
5638486P1.text: Amazing, it was the coolest experience I've ever had. Besides the views, the owners are the friendliest people I've ever met! They offered me cava and took a lot of pictures. He has taught us by boat inside, stories with big fish in the sea! Something worth more than once in your life! Thank you for having such a great heart!
5638486P1.author: P5422QXmariak

42358P2.title: Around Istán
42358P2.text: The conclusion first: I can recommend a tour with Johanna without restriction. We were picked up on time, picked up more hikes and drove quickly to the starting point. Under Johanna’s guidance we hiked around 13 km around Istán. Best hiking weather and a group of nice people made the hours fly by. The route was quite challenging with several steep climbs. Although some of the fellow hikers had known each other for some time and from previous tours, the newcomers were well received. We found one path overgrown by heavy vegetation, a failure of the relevant organizations. Then we had to go throu
42358P2.author: kaiserdirk

42358P2.title: El Hacho above Gaucin
42358P2.text: Wishing for challenging walks in beautiful surroundings with an experienced multilingual skilled guide in a small group? Join Sur walks tours! Johanna picks you up and drops you off for the walks at set meeting points around Estepona and Marbella. She knows the way around the mountains and shows you places and views off the beaten tracks. This is probably the 20 th walk with her through the years and we will definetely return again.
42358P2.author: LisenNacka

42358P2.title: The most beautiful walks in Andalusia!
42358P2.text:
In the mountains, through the (chestnut) forests, through beautiful villages, along the beautiful beach in Tarifa, the hikes with Johanna and her dog Luke take you to the most beautiful places in Andalusia. In May and October 2024 I did a total of 10 hikes. Always with different people, small group, international company, that also makes it fascinating. Many beautiful white villages seen. Often we could enjoy tapas there after the walk. 

Jimena de la Frontera, Casares, Pujerra, El Burgo, along the Guadalmina river, El Hacho mountain and the village of Gaucin, La Concha (house mountain near Ma
42358P2.author: 355odav

107194P381.title: Excellent
107194P381.text: This expeirence was great,me and my family had a great time exploring the local area and answering questions and finding answers to the questions.This app and experince is very good and we had a great time.
107194P381.author: Dreamer18583413530

107194P381.title: It saved our day!
107194P381.text: It saved our day! It was cloudy and we wanted to explore the city and its hidden corners, but the kids get bored on regular tours. With this game we could explore the historic center at our own pace, taking breaks to rest and grab something to eat, then continue right where we left off. We loved it! Highly recommended!
107194P381.author: X9868YLvickyj

107194P381.title: The kids loved it.
107194P381.text: Fun way to see a city centre with small kids. Easy to find and follow. Good game and game app to use. We will try it in more cities with the kids.
107194P381.author: ulrikap2024

17739P2.text:
Even though the hotel never forgets that it has more than 600 rooms, making it a real tourist factory, the staff shows both professionalism and friendliness. This gives a total holiday feeling that never leaves.
I didn't once feel like I was being treated like a "client", except sometimes by the other...clients! Congratulations also for the efforts on behalf of PMRs and other disabled people, I benefited from the complicity in this matter of my walker , delighted to have had an excellent holiday for him.
17739P2.author: jm2xloup

17739P2.title: Half day was perfect
17739P2.text: This easy half day trip was a great way to begin our Spain experience. Rocio was an excellent guide and very personable. We arrived in Mijas early and got to explore the town almost alone. During the free time everything was open and the town was bustling. Beautiful setting and small, quaint town was fun to explore.
17739P2.author: Terri_P

17739P2.title: Exactly what we wanted!
17739P2.text:
We were picked up at the cruise port on time and driven to Mijas (exactly what we wanted). The driver was not a tour guide, just a driver, which was fine with our group. In Mijas we were met by a tour guide who took us around the town and then we had free time to explore the area on our own. The driver then took us back to Malaga and we had additional time to explore (on our own) there before our cruise ship left the port.

There was a little issue initially in booking, but it was all resolved to our satisfaction. We'd use this company again.
17739P2.author: atwell4

461880P1.title: Dolphins experience
461880P1.text: We had an amazing two hours on the boat with Miguel. We were lucky enough to be the only family on the boat and again super lucky to see Dolphins after are dip in the sea. The food was lovely and we had a good selection of drinks. We would highly recommend, amazing value for money and an unforgettable experience
461880P1.author: floridamad

461880P1.title: Miguel was our captain...
461880P1.text: Miguel was our captain and he really took care of us as a group of 6 adults.  He brought us drinks and snacks, enabled us to use Bluetooth for our own music and showed us where the fish were likely to be by observing the sea birds. And all this while navigating the sailboat perfectly!  Although the dolphins didn’t come out to play, it didn’t matter at all and we all enjoyed the peace of being out at sea!
461880P1.author: Kathleen_A

461880P1.title: Great sunny trip!
461880P1.text: We had a great trip out, really accommodating and nice captain. Food and drinks supplied - lovely afternoon. The boat was clean and modern and felt very safe.
461880P1.author: B992ROlauras

104357P140.title: Our guide, Michael, was...
104357P140.text: Our guide, Michael, was terrific and he was very enjoyable to spend time with. A wonderful guide to walk around with.
104357P140.author: Bruce_K

104357P140.title: Nice Introduction to Marbella!
104357P140.text:
I was traveling solo on this trip and only in Marbella for two nights. This 3 hour walking tour was the perfect way to learn about a new city. I have done similar walking tours in other new cities I visited with similar success. 

Nicola messaged me the night before confirming our time and location meeting. He met me at my hotel and we started our adventure for the next 3 hours. He was personable and knowledgeable of the city, sharing some history as well. 

I got a terrific overview of this fabulous city and logged over 12,000 steps! 

Thank you Nicola! 

Steve
104357P140.author: Happiness66090625471

104357P140.title: Highly Recommended Tour
104357P140.text: "I highly recommend taking a tour with Oliver! He knows Marbella inside and out, and he takes you to all the historic and trendy spots. His knowledge of the city's history is truly impressive and I like the way he tailored the tour based on what i was interested in. If you want to really get to know Marbella, this tour is a must. By the end, I felt like a local, and I'm already planning my next visit!"
104357P140.author: Dee_S

17739P15.title: Fantastic Christmas Eve Excursion to Gibraltar
17739P15.text: Wonderful experience! Great guide! We picked a short private trip for Christmas Eve and St. Michaels cave felt very festive. As it was the holidays we had the monkeys almost to ourselves! Gorgeous sunny day to work our way up the rock, visit the siege tunnels and learn the history of Gibraltar. My daughter was particularly interested in the land reclamation efforts as well. Highly recommend this tour! We also had a Marbella transfer that brought us to the border crossing and met us again at the end of the tour.  Very well orchestrated!
17739P15.author: Staci_C

17739P15.title: Our guide, Tom, was...
17739P15.text: Our guide, Tom, was excellent!!!    Very knowledgeable and friendly.   My grandsons loved the monkeys.   The driver was on time and professional.
17739P15.author: Lesa_J

17739P15.title: Great tour
17739P15.text: Wonderful guide. Very informative and personable. Great experience. The tour service did not convey the tour end time very well, but that was not the tour guides fault. Wish we had more time to explore on our own.
17739P15.author: Michael_R

158317P6.title: Great day out
158317P6.text: Excellent day out and our guess, Julio and Raul were both great. Thanks very much. The views were amazing and everything felt very safe when we were there
158317P6.author: Dr_W

158317P6.title: Great experience with great guides. Well worth it
158317P6.text: An excellent day out with amazing views and some excellent climbs. Good for beginners and it all felt very safe. Julio and Raul were both excellent and very friendly. They took care of us every step of the way and took some amazing photos for us as we went round.
158317P6.author: Georges-1999

158317P6.title: Great climbing experience
158317P6.text:
Julio and Raul were excellent guides, picked us up from our apartment (unexpected bonus), agreed to a later start so we got a lie in (another unexpected bonus).

After a good safety briefing and a quick check of the kit, up we ascended. Great experience for young and old. If you are afraid of heights may be avoid.  Difficulty not too bad if you are comfortable with a bit of excercise and happy to walk over some boulders to get to the start and end.

We didn't need to bring anything, photos courtesy of the guides on a Go Pro which they text, ice cold drink and a snack bar provided, plus water d
158317P6.author: Sam E

69172P1.title: Great day with friends
69172P1.text:
We had a guided tour from Maggie…..who was really great and very informative…..the whole experience was great right from the start……then to finish off tasting the wines from a magnificent setting made our day. 
Would highly recommend this to everyone a truly lovely day.
69172P1.author: S808RGannep

69172P1.title: Winemaking and tapas with spectacular views
69172P1.text: great review of organic winemaking in the old way in the village. Engaged and knowledgeable guide. Beautiful view over the Mediterranean further up in the vineyard.
69172P1.author: frank_L2226FA

69172P1.title: Fun and educational
69172P1.text:
We are all incredibly happy with this experience! Magali was both knowledgeable and fun to listen to
Thanks for today!
69172P1.author: 534caroline

17739P102.title: The beauty of Estepona shines even when the sol does not.
17739P102.text: We often book a walking tour when in a city for the first time and find that getting the perspective of a knowledgeable local person is a good way to familiarize ourselves. This tour of Estepona did not disappoint and Rocio provided wonderful commentary and insights. She is an enthusiastic guide who braved the rain with us with resolve and optimism and provided a tour that permitted appreciation of the artistic and natural beauty of Estepona.
17739P102.author: Carolerange326

17739P102.title: Colors, art, and warmth in Estepona: an unforgettable family experience
17739P102.text: Our visit to Estepona was a magical experience for the whole family. A perfect getaway that blended art, culture, and unforgettable moments in a place that truly captured our hearts
17739P102.author: Y6264FLannes

17739P102.title: Fab tour would highly recommend
17739P102.text:
the actual walking tour and guide Rocia were really good and informative and would recommend
We had the private tour and was surprised we were not collected from our hotel, which on all the other privare tours we have
17739P102.author: D_N

17739P99.title: Great trip
17739P99.text: Great trip and guides. Fun day with friends seeing both sites. Would recommend. Ayose, our driver, and Rocio were fun!
17739P99.author: Dawn_J

17739P99.title: Worth the Trek To Rhonda
17739P99.text:
Rhonda absolutely should be visited and never missed. Stunning, iconic scenery and views. Our driver was professional, punctual, accommodating and friendly. 
Rosario, our guide in Rhonda was knowledgeable, sweet and patient. Having Rosario was a great way to learn about the city and then have time to explore on your own. Sentinele De Las Bodegas could take it or leave it.  It was neat to see, and worth stopping by since so close to Rhonda and we made the trek up there. Would only recommend the Sentinele stop if not a busy time of year.
17739P99.author: Dulcy_M

354655P1.title: Brilliant Experience
354655P1.text: Booked 3 quads with grandparents and a 6 and 8 year old. Our guide was absolutely fantastic, wonderful views from the mountains and a swim underneath a waterfall. Went at a steady pace and would definitely recommend. There is some driving on main roads out of Marbella, but once in the mountains fantastic experience.
354655P1.author: jollymuncher

354655P1.title: Perfect
354655P1.text:
We had a wonderful time, beyond our expectations. We walked inland with a view of the sea, we even caught a glimpse of Africa, 
Swimming in a natural water hole,
The guide is very friendly! 
I recommend it 100%

Susie and Maxime
354655P1.author: 352susieu

354655P1.title: Great!
354655P1.text:
I went yesterday and really enjoyed it!
Thanks it was a great trip!
354655P1.author: 625helleb

129645P1.title: Christian gave amazing food tour
129645P1.text: Got to taste many different local foods with knowledgeable and personable guide Christian.  He chose many dishes and wines to go with them that were all amazing.
129645P1.author: Elizabeth_L

129645P1.title: Just do it, you won‘t regret
129645P1.text: Christian knows Marbella like the back of his hand; he’ll show you restaurants you wouldn’t otherwise find and tell you all about the city. He’ll tailor the tour to your needs—just ask. He’s very friendly, pleasant, and down-to-earth. For a special walking experience, ask for Pablo 🐕 ;)
129645P1.author: VKLnr

129645P1.title: Great evening
129645P1.text: Christian was a fantastic guide very knowledgeable and fun .The evening was a truly memorable experience and a huge thank you to Christian
129645P1.author: C1632WHjane

5648418P1.title: A great ride a great experience
5648418P1.text: Had a wonderful tour with Dennis. Great ride great views and a great experience. Dennis was very knowledgeable on the area . Highly recommend it . No riding experience required
5648418P1.author: Decroi

5648418P1.title: Great Bike Trip round Marbella/Benahavis
5648418P1.text:
Did this trip today.  Shared a bike as I didn’t want to drive one myself!  Met at the office just before midday, with plenty of nearby parking, and Chris our guide explained how the bike worked.  All very easy.

We were the only ones on this tour, which we had also got half price @€60 each.  We rode round Marbella and Benahavis, and then up into the hills.  Had a couple of photo stops with far reaching views.

Great fun and highly recommend.
5648418P1.author: llamacalmer

5648418P1.title: Amazing
5648418P1.text:
One of the best experiences in Marbella. 
The Can-Am Rykers are super intuitive and so fun.
The guide knew exactly where to take us to discover beautifull landscapes.
5648418P1.author: dizzy v

264443P1.title: Outdoor adrenaline and adventure while visiting Andalucia
264443P1.text: We had an amazing canyoning trip, with an excellent combination of amazing scenery, adventure, and fun in the water. We went as a family of four with two teenagers (13 and 15), and this was perfect. Trip includes some hiking, rappelling, jumping off rocks into ice cold water, and amazing scenery as you are literally walking through a crack in the earth. The guides were excellent as well. Highly recommended!
264443P1.author: H5286DXnathanm

307099P73.title: Easy way to do the Caminito!
307099P73.text: Such an easy way to get to the Caminito and enjoy a nice experience without any stress of self-planning. The driver picked us up at our Resort, dropped us off as close to the Caminito as he could, and then was available for us within 5 minutes of our finishing. They bought the tickets for the company needto in advance as well and sent them to my phone. Easy peasy.
307099P73.author: Roving40940034400

307099P73.title: Lovely trip!
307099P73.text: The driver picked us up as agreed. All of the communication went very well. Lovely trip in fantastic surroundings. Recommended!
307099P73.author: 396siljeb

409474P3.title: Marvelous Marbella with Marie
409474P3.text: We had an amazing walking tour with Marie Carmen . She was passionate and shared so many wonderful stories on the history of Marbellla.
409474P3.author: Rashmi_G

409474P3.title: Informative walking tour through the old town
409474P3.text: It is a walking tour and not a bus tour, please change this in the headline. We had our very competent tour guide Raffa all to ourselves and he told us everything worth knowing about Marbella and led us through the old town up to the old castle walls. Even though we had already walked through the old town ourselves before, it is always good to also hear something about the history of a city. We really enjoyed the excursion!
409474P3.author: Trip64542407432

409474P3.title: More than I expected
409474P3.text: The tour was fantastic! I would never have realized there was such history in Marbella. They are so proud of their culture, and rightly so. I tour guide, Mara-Carmen was so knowledgeable and engaging. She made the tour very enjoyable.
409474P3.author: Michael_S

102398P7.title: Marbella's Old City Through the Eyes of a Local
102398P7.text: A wonderful and truly inspiring guided tour through Marbella’s Old Town, full of fascinating details and interesting insights. Our guide’s enthusiasm and love for her city were absolutely contagious. Thank you so much for this memorable experience!
102398P7.author: anjawasthere

102398P7.title: Marbella Tour and Olive Oil Tasting
102398P7.text: This is an amazing tour! It is very enjoyable and informative, and the olive oil tasting is a highlight!
102398P7.author: Bridgette_C

102398P7.title: Best walking tour
102398P7.text: I've been on a number of walking tours and this one was excellent. Javi was a fantastic tour guide. He was extremely welcoming and knowledgeable about Marbella. Whether the subject was dining, shopping, history or other cultural references, Javi had a wealth of insights. In fact, we followed a food recommendation from him after the tour and had our best meal in Spain. I just wish that we had found him earlier in our trip to experience more of Andalucia with his local touch.
102398P7.author: jessear

107194P377.title: Ideal tour to go with children
107194P377.text:
It is an activity to do with children, otherwise, there is no magic.
I think there are very nice and interesting spots of estepona that are also in the center area, but in general it is a tour to do something different and enjoy the excitement of the little ones.
107194P377.author: Malena_G

107194P377.title: Positive holiday
107194P377.text: Pretty city by the sea, rich in flowers and vegetation. I really liked it, and I recommend it to both young people and people older in age
107194P377.author: Flyer57704228052

107194P377.title: Lovely day out
107194P377.text: Really enjoyable experience had by all. We got to see lots of the really beautiful streets of Estepona. Loved it❤️. Highly recommended
107194P377.author: 865emilym

29895P10.title: Dressed to hike by Lara
29895P10.text: My suitcase had not arrived at the time I was to begin my hiking tour in Sicily through Explore. LARA MANSFELD was our guide and I anticipated my hiking vacation turning into a beach vacation. But Lara was able to outfit me with boots (that fit), poles, pants and jacket. Not only was she a terrific guide who knew her stuff about Mt Etna, Riserva National Park etc but her hidden talent of "clothier" came in handy. KUDOS to a wonderful woman and guide
29895P10.author: barbarawE2429KP

29895P10.title: Ronda is amazing especially with costa!
29895P10.text:
This trip was our favorite in our 10 days in Spain. From the initial communication to pick up the communication was top notch. Our driver Thomas, was much more than just a transport driver. He was a second guide. He shared his love of the country and answered all Spain questions. He took us to the bottom of the gorge to look up at the bridge.  He also was a master of maneuvering around town. 

Our local guide, Antonio, was equally awesome. His sophistication,  knowledge and passion of  Ronda transcended the day. He navigated the busy streets to make us feel like we were in a small town. He rel
29895P10.author: khansen

29895P10.title: Highly recommend this tour
29895P10.text: Oliver is an excellent guide. He is very knowledgeable about the whole region and offered the best pro tips to maximize the return of our trip. From the restaurant recommendations to the best vantage points for picture taking, this tour and Oliver in particular significantly exceeded our expectations.
29895P10.author: Dan_Z

104802P2.title: Only Authentic Sailboat in the Area!
104802P2.text: This is an authentic sailing experience - not just a motorized boat with a sail! The captain is fun and knowledgeable. We didn’t see dolphins this time but the day was so enjoyable, we didn’t even really care. Beautiful day, good people and a great trip! Highly recommend this tour!
104802P2.author: Dena_E

104802P2.title: Fabulous boat trip
104802P2.text:
We had a lovely days sailing on the boat. 
Robert was very friendly and knowledgeable he provided us with lots of lovely food and drink. 
We did not want the trip to end I throughly recommended this trip having a 360 view all the time.
104802P2.author: pheasant49

104802P2.title: Dolphins
104802P2.text: Had an amazing sailing trip seeing so many dolphins close up. Food & drink was perfect. Glad we did the 4 hour trip as it was enough time for dolphin watching and swimming at a relaxed pace.
104802P2.author: 960sharon

158317P11.title: Fun and secure
158317P11.text: Very well organized. We enjoyed the activity. The jumps were safe, although a little scary for my first time, but easy once you take your first jump. The water was comfortable for October. The guides were very knowledgeable and made our jumps easy.
158317P11.author: Stephen_P

158317P11.title: Brilliant
158317P11.text: A fantastic experience for myself and my 11 year old son. The perfect level of challenging for us, I would say for an 8 year old you would need to be very capable as need to abseil down a 4m dam and it’s hard work at times swimming through but a fantastic experience I would and have recommended to anyone!
158317P11.author: DonP372

158317P11.title: Wet, wild and fun!
